tasks.name: Root on the Mainframe
tasks.description: A cracked gateway still serves a retro time-sharing system on the lab network. Inspect the host at 172.20.0.141 and recover the protected record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: The account can inspect the host, but some system records are out of reach. Look for differences in how ordinary programs are installed and permitted to run.
Check the system's special permission bits and compare the results with familiar command-line utilities that have documented shell escapes.
One familiar utility runs with elevated effective privileges. See whether its documented escape can start a shell that preserves those privileges, then inspect the protected root-only records.
